nina_cs: FYI — Aurora Labs private deploy dry-run uncovered three quick items: telemetry egress CIDR, KMS policy scope, and CloudTrail cross-account bucket ACL. Dropping notes so we can patch runbook before cutover.
raj_net: what failed in the dry-run?
nina_cs: their infra applied a broad egress rule (0.0.0.0/0) because our example lacked a suggested CIDR. caused security hold. snippet they used: `az network nsg rule create --name allow-telemetry --priority 100 --protocol Tcp --destination-port-ranges 443 --destination-address-prefixes 0.0.0.0/0`
raj_net: we should add a recommended public netblock (e.g., 198.51.100.0/24) and a VPC endpoint option for no-egress mode. I'll add a terraform snippet and a curl verify.
isabel_sec: KMS: customer role had `kms:*`. we'll replace with least-priv sample and call out `kms:CreateGrant` for temporary creds. also note rotation impact: quarterly default; monthly requires maintenance window.
frank_eng: small KMS example to include: `{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999:alias/aurora-key"}]}`
frank_eng: CloudTrail: forwarding failed with AccessDenied to central bucket. add cross-account PutObject + PutObjectAcl example and checklist: SSE, object-lock retention >=1y, block-public-access.
ops-bot: Checklist updated: added tasks "Telemetry CIDR", "KMS least-priv example", "CloudTrail cross-account policy". Runbook draft at /runbooks/aurora-priv-dryrun.
nina_cs: next steps: raj/frank update runbook today, isabel to add security rationale, i'll schedule 30m sync with Aurora infra tomorrow 10:30 PT. tagging as potential renewal risk if monthly rotation is mandated without a maintenance SLA.
isabel_sec: agreed. i'll flag renewal_risk in the account notes.
raj_net: will post terraform + verify commands in the runbook PR.
frank_eng: adding one-liner to verify KMS grants: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <id>`.
nina_cs: thanks all — will send invite and close loop after second dry-run.
